info.title: ACE
info.description: ACE's JSON API. A request authenticates with an API key as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`, or with a GUI session's cookie from ACE's own pages.

get.summary:
The alerts the filters match, newest first or in the order asked, a page at a time, with how many
match in all. Follow `next` until it's null, with the same filters and order: each order breaks ties by
the alert's id, so an alert that arrives meanwhile never shifts a later page.

parameters.name: f
parameters.description:
A filter in the share-link encoding, `[!]<slug>:<value>,<value>`, with the alert screen's slugs
(`GET /api/filters/v1/screens/alerts`); repeat it for more. Filters are ANDed, the values of one
ORed, and `!` inverts one.

parameters.name: tz
parameters.description: The IANA timezone relative date filters (`-7d`, `@d`) resolve in; UTC when left out.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many alerts, 1 to 1000; 100 when left out.

400.description: A filter, order, timezone or limit that isn't one, a cursor of another order or that names no alert, or filters that took too long

401.description: No credential, or one that isn't valid

get.summary:
Every alert the list's filters match, in its order, as CSV: a header line, then a row per alert, with a
cell that a spreadsheet would read as a formula behind a `'`. A failure part-way ends the file there.

parameters.name: f
parameters.description: A filter, as the list takes it; repeat it for more.

parameters.name: tz
parameters.description: The IANA timezone relative date filters resolve in; UTC when left out.

400.description: A filter, order or timezone that isn't one, or filters that took too long

401.description: No credential, or one that isn't valid

413.description: More alerts than an export holds

get.summary:
Every alert the list's filters match, in its order, as NDJSON: an alert as the list gives it on each
line. A failure part-way ends it with an `{"error": ...}` line.

parameters.name: f
parameters.description: A filter, as the list takes it; repeat it for more.

parameters.name: tz
parameters.description: The IANA timezone relative date filters resolve in; UTC when left out.

401.description: No credential, or one that isn't valid

413.description: More alerts than an export holds

get.summary: One alert, with how many observables, files and detections it holds.

400.description: An id that isn't a uuid

401.description: No credential, or one that isn't valid

post.summary:
Confirms every unconfirmed inherited TP of the alert (source `inherited_multi`): each becomes an explicit
TP, which weighs more when signature changes are tested.

400.description: An id that isn't one

401.description: No credential, or one that isn't valid

403.description: The actor doesn't hold alert:write, or a session's request came from another site

409.description: The alert's disposition doesn't take the actor's verdicts

put.summary:
Stores a verdict on one detection of a TP alert: `fp` marks it as noise, `tp` confirms it. Storing what's
stored already changes nothing and writes no audit row.

400.description: A verdict that isn't `tp` or `fp`, a body that isn't one, or an id that isn't one

401.description: No credential, or one that isn't valid

403.description: The actor doesn't hold alert:write, or a session's request came from another site

404.description: No such alert, or the alert has no such detection

409.description: The alert's disposition doesn't take the actor's verdicts: an FP or unclassified alert, whose disposition is what to correct, or one only ACE sets

delete.summary:
Removes the stored verdict on one detection, so it inherits from the alert again. Removing none changes
nothing and writes no audit row.

400.description: An id that isn't one

401.description: No credential, or one that isn't valid

403.description: The actor doesn't hold alert:write, or a session's request came from another site

404.description: No such alert, or the alert has no such detection

409.description: The alert's disposition doesn't take the actor's verdicts

put.summary:
Records an analyst's verdict on the alert. Its analysis is cancelled and it moves to the
dispositioned mode. A later disposition replaces the earlier one and who made it. A root that no
detection made an alert can be dispositioned too, as the service allows. The disposition is one of
the site's, and one only ACE sets is refused, as is a change to an alert that has one.

400.description: Not one of the site's dispositions, one only ACE sets, or a body that isn't one

401.description: No credential, or one that isn't valid

403.description: The actor doesn't hold alert:write, or a session's request came from another site

409.description: The alert's disposition is one only ACE sets, which an analyst can't change

observables. It's read from one snapshot of the alert's tree, and bounded, saying so when it was cut.

400.description: An id that isn't a uuid

401.description: No credential, or one that isn't valid

post.summary:

it exits or its deadline: when a pool takes it, plus its timeout. Closing the session that started it
doesn't stop it. Follow it at `GET /api/cli/v1/commands/{id}`.

400.description: A command line that's empty, doesn't split, starts with an option or is too long, a timeout out of range, or a body that isn't one

401.description: No credential, or one that isn't valid

403.description: The actor doesn't hold cli:execute, isn't a person (an API key with no owner), or a session's request came from another site
